notes.title: JOIN US ON OPEN PLAYTEST 16.05.21 AT 17:00 GMT!
notes.content:
Hello, mages!

Please come join us 16th of May 2021 on a public playtest at 17:00 GMT! We are looking forward to spending time with you as you would help us to create a better game.

If you encounter any problems during gameplay, go to [url=https://discord.com/invite/gDbCJwJ]Discord[/url] #bugreports channel and post your bug report there, following the instructions. It really helps.

Please keep in mind that this is not a final version of the game and not even a beta version. Our plans on this playtesting is to see how servers operate and how stable game is with enough players joining the sessions.

-----------------------------------------

Two more Earth spells were added this week:

"Clod"
During preparation mage quickly lifts several rocks in the air and collides them with each other one by one, forming a hude clod and then launches it.
Holding left mouse button is required to form a clod. Release to launch. If clod is fully formed, it launches automatically. On lower levels or not fully formed clod flies fast and in relatively straight trajectory. The more rocks there is, the heavier clod will be, resulting in slower movement speed and less straight trajectory. Worth noting that forming a clod required strong concentration from a mage, so it is easy to interrupt this spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814397/7d817ceb3931646439df2eff1d4273be964726c9.gif[/img]

"Bog"
It is an area of effect spell which covers a selected region on a surface with a boiling viscous mud. Everyone inside it start accumulating a "Dirt" status, which slows down movement speed the more Dirt there is. When reaching 100%, Dirt changes to Petrification.
Bog can be set on fire using fire spells. Then everyone inside will be also set on fire instead of get covered in dirt.

Also new spell parameter was added: Complexity. This parameter adds ability to approximate how difficult it is to prepare a spell from the perspective of managing concentration.
Default value is 10, lesser values mean more comfortable casting and less influence on concentration when moving around. Larger values mean the opposite: spell is easier to fail when actively moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39814397/04daaf43b57e7d8e35a6b877af7734ad3ef693b7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: JOIN US ON OPEN PLAYTEST!
notes.content:
Hello, mages!

Please come join us 9th of May 2021 on a public playtest at 17:00 GMT! We are looking forward to spending time with you as you would help us to create a better game.

If you encounter any problems during gameplay, go to [url=https://discord.com/invite/gDbCJwJ]Discord[/url] #bugreports channel and post your bug report there, following the instructions. It really helps.

Please keep in mind that this is not a final version of the game and not even a beta version. Our plans on this playtesting is to see how servers operate and how stable game is with enough players joining the sessions.

-----------------------------------------

Two new things were added during last two weeks:

[b]1. New Earth magic branch![/b]
Currently available:
"Pillar", "Stone wall" and "Stone curse", as well as new status "Dirt".
In active development: "Clod" and "Bog".
More details on Earth spells are coming in future posts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571770/e06d6b74802be04e012c61d4f3783ece2d295819.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39571770/0c901d11af5322b5891ca8837f5c7cf317c6b309.gif[/img]

[b]2. Game now has bots![/b]
Billies, as well as Willies will compensate for the lack of players. They are always on and playtests will be held with their attendance.

Also some fixed and changes:

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
- Casting is now disabled in spawning areas
- Added new perk "Stronger kick" that increases damage and power of kicks
- Health of all players is increased from 100 to 120
- Speed of performing a ritual is decreased a bit
- Spells splash damage is not dealing through obstacles

[b]Balance:[/b]
- Fireball now has lower splash damage
- Lowered speed bonus for projectiles when having "Assassin II" perk

[b]Fixed bugs:[/b]
- Fireball's direct hit now pushes the target
- When bying chronum, it wasn't adding up, but ether was being removed

[b]Bots:[/b]
- Bots no longer reach to invisible players

[b]Sound:[/b]
- Added new music before the start of the match
- Added new jingle for the defeat

[b]UI:[/b]
- In spellarium when hovering over the spell and ability slots, description now displays
- Main menu has new background which will be worked on in the future
